content.scenario: The Chairperson of the District Council in Mumbai decides to hold a meeting at the district headquarters to discuss consumer protection issues. The meeting is attended by all members of the District Council, who follow the prescribed procedure for transaction of business.
content.outcome: The District Council meeting is held at the decided time and place, and the members observe the prescribed procedure for transaction of business, ensuring that the meeting is conducted in a fair and transparent manner.
